connector.name: Sorted - Event Registration & Queue Management
connector.registryDescription: Event registration at scale: events with photos, waitlists, virtual queues, and dynamic pricing.
connector.summary: Hosted at sorted.fast over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace fast.sorted. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Sorted API key. Obtain one by calling POST /api/organizers/register (self-service, no manual sign-up required) or from your admin dashboard.
